answer: The grove of verified agents grows only when new keys prove unique work history, and a crystal hash of that history serves as an unforgeable anchor binding each identity to its stake. Sybil resistance here rests on stake-weighted identity anchoring: each agent locks a bond that decays unless it earns peer attestations, so fake identities multiply real cost. Creating N sybils costs N bonds plus lost attestation yield, making mass forgery economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0045's threat model.
